positive_notes: Voice processing remains an input capability and does not duplicate weekly report or insight finalization writes.
Duration validation happens before download/transcription/draft mutation.
Local audio paths are built through StoragePathPolicy and covered by unsafe-fragment regressions.
Weekly report deadline, duplicate, selected-step, and insight progress-isolation guards remain in the owning flow services.
No new live Telegram, Google, OpenAI, Whisper, Docker, Redis, Celery, or PostgreSQL dependencies were introduced.

findings.title: Saved voice insights display only voice transcription instead of the full mixed insight text
findings.description: Insight finalization stores the full mixed text in insight_text and voice-only text in transcription_text, which is correct. However list_insights/get_full_text build display items through _insight_item_from_row, which currently prefers transcription_text over insight_text. For a mixed text plus voice insight, the saved row is correct but the participant-facing list/full-text view will show only the voice-only fragment and omit surrounding typed text.
findings.evidence: Task 5 added final save tests for row fields, but no regression opens a saved voice insight through list_insights or get_full_text after final save. The implementation path at app/services/insights.py:231 calls format_full_insight_text(_insight_item_from_row(row)); _insight_item_from_row reads transcription_text before insight_text.
findings.recommendation: Change _insight_item_from_row to use insight_text as the participant-facing full text and preview. Keep transcription_text as a business/audit column, not the preferred display body. Add a regression that saves mixed text plus voice, then calls get_full_text and verifies the full mixed insight text is shown.

findings.title: Voice failure path does not persist failed draft attachment metadata when the local audio path is already known
findings.description: The tech spec says download/save/transcription failures should record failed technical attachment state when possible. The current repositories expose only append_voice_transcription for success rows, and VoiceMessageService catches failures after download/transcription without storing a failed draft_attachments row. This preserves drafts and routes admin notifications correctly, but loses failure metadata that the schema was designed to hold.
findings.evidence: draft_attachments supports transcription_status = failed and error_message, but both repository methods insert only transcription_status = success. VoiceMessageService catches exceptions at app/services/voice_messages.py:97 and notifies admin without a repository call to persist failed metadata.
findings.recommendation: If failed attachment observability is still required, add repository methods for failed attachment rows and call them when destination_path/local_file_path is known. Keep this separate from draft_messages so failed voice attempts do not add user-visible text.
